concept.title: Where your trees are saved
concept.shortdesc: Your trees are kept inside uFTi on your , so save a copy as a file to keep one where you can find it.

conbody.p: Each workspace is one family tree file. saves your changes to that file as you go. A new tree is kept in a folder named workspaces, which belongs to . So is the copy that makes when you open a file.

section.title: Find the file of a tree
section.p: Choose on the card of a tree on . It gives the name of the file, the folder, and the day it was last saved, such as My family tree.ged in workspaces. The sample tree says in uFTi.

section.title: You cannot see the folder from outside the app
section.p: The Files app does not show it.
Android's screen for choosing a file does not show it.
It is inside the Library folder of your Mac, which the Finder hides. You do not need to go there.
To have a file of your tree that you can see, send or keep somewhere else, choose on its card. says how.

section.title: If you remove the app
section.p: Removing removes the trees kept inside it. Before you remove it, save a copy of each tree you want to keep with , and put the copy somewhere else. A file you opened from elsewhere, such as Downloads, stays where it was.

section.title: Trees you open from a file
section.p: The file you choose stays where it was, and works on its own copy. says what happens to each.
